title: Atelier
summary: Marketplace for handmade goods with seller studios, orders and payments.
description: A marketplace where makers sell handmade pieces. Buyers shop and follow their orders; sellers run a studio with stock and earnings; an admin approves products. Rules stop overselling stock and buying your own piece, and a payment webhook marks orders paid.
roles_summary: Buyers sign up. Sellers run a studio. An admin approves products.
includes: Shop with product pages and a cart
Seller studio with stock and earnings
highlights: Rules: stock limits, no buying your own product
Buyers and sellers see only their own orders
